_note: Grounding test set for the launch language cnr (Montenegrin, Latin script). 20 answerable + 10 unanswerable questions. The expected answers were prepared independently from the retrieval pipeline, by reading the seed facts (seed_data/heritage_entries.json) and the public sources cited there; they are the reference a human uses when checking the run, never an input to the assistant. 'expected_slugs' lists the approved entries that may legitimately be cited. The unanswerable block contains (a) three questions whose answer exists ONLY in non-approved sample entries (draft golden bell 1687, reviewed old school 41 pupils, rejected Roman villa 1999), (b) two questions about Gornji Stoliv, seeded as an unverified draft, and (c) five off-topic questions outside the territory and the mandate of the assistant.

questions.question: Koje crkve ima selo Gornja Lastva?

questions.question: Čemu su posvećeni Dani pejzaža?
